header.title: Credentials, media, and locations
header.body: Add organization details and choose what may be shared.
header.boundary: Information provided by the organization is not automatically verification, qualification, endorsement, or a credibility badge.

common.error: The update could not be saved. Your existing records were not changed.

credentials.boundary: Adding a credential or supporting document does not verify it. Verification remains a separate process.
credentials.label: Credential name
credentials.empty: No credentials or identifiers have been recorded.

media.add: Upload organization media or a document
media.boundary: Uploads start private. Publishing is a separate, reversible action, and private supporting material is not published here.
media.title: Title
media.alt: Alternative text · required for visual assets
media.uploaded: The file is private and ready for you to review before publishing.
media.empty: No organization media or documents have been uploaded.

locations.boundary: Additional locations remain part of this organization and use the same locality and privacy rules as the organization profile.
locations.label: Location label
locations.privateAddress: This is a home or private address
locations.empty: No additional organization locations have been confirmed.
locations.mapHelp: Your primary organization marker remains distinct from additional locations. Each location uses the privacy level you select.
